answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 8469 Country: India Title: My dear scholar,we have a lot of problems in our house.my dad as lost his business and has karz of about 2700000 and we have lot of miseries in our home.i am not getting interest in my studies and i getting failed in exams before i was a rank holder sir please help me so that i can do something for my dad and family. Question: assalamu alaikum My dear scholar,we have a lot of problems in our house.my dad as lost his business and has karz of about 2700000 and we have lot of miseries in our home.i am not getting interest in my studies and i getting failed in exams before i was a rank holder sir please help me so that i can do something for my dad and family Answer ID: 8469 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1853/D=123/K=1429) Recite the below dua three hundred times with durood before and after: اللھم اکفنی بحلالک عن حرامک و اغننی بفضلک عمن سواک (2) Recite ya wahhab ( یا وھاب ) 414 times with 7 times durood before and after . In-sha-Allah, your debts shall be paid easily. (3) Make fresh ablution, offer two rakat nafl salah , your needs shall be fulfilled, i n-sha-Allah! Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
